examples.value: A chronic condition characterized by resistance to insulin and relative insulin deficiency.
Absence of diabetes diagnosis used as the healthy control state in the metadata.

Type 1 diabetes (T1D) is a chronic autoimmune form of diabetes in which the immune system destroys insulin-producing pancreatic beta cells. The resulting loss of endogenous insulin production causes hyperglycemia; in established disease, exogenous insulin is required for survival. T1D is diagnosed more often in children and young adults but can develop at any age. Genetic susceptibility and environmental factors may contribute to disease initiation, but the specific trigger is not fully established.

value: This human reference interactome (HuRI) was generated by performing nine two-hybrid screens with the high confidence interactions determined by pairwise verification by quadruplicate retesting and sequence confirmation. This HI-III-20 dataset contains over 52,000 PPIs involving more than 8,000 proteins.

SAINTexpress (v.3.6.1) was used to identify proximity interactions and those with a Bayesian FDR =< 0.01 were considered high confidence. The score represents the fold change of the average spectral count in sample replicates relative to the average in control replicates.
Bait generated from library of CRISPR-edited human embryonic kidney (HEK) 293T cell lines harboring fluorescent tags on individual proteins
